_about: Declarative definition of what the Founding 10 snapshot needs for Next Level Answer (agent edition). Read by hl_build.py. Source: snapshot-build/automation-blueprints.md and saas-build-spec.md section 3 and 13. Keys that start with an underscore are notes and are never sent to the API. No client data and no phone numbers belong in this file.

api._verify: Every endpoint page read on 2026-11-15 lists the Version header option as v3. The Private Integrations page shows an example with Version 2021-07-28. If v3 is refused, run with --api-version 2021-07-28.

calendars.name: Call with {{custom_values.nl_owner_name}}
calendars._verify: Name taken from the spec. Whether a calendar name renders a custom value is not confirmed. If it shows the braces, rename it by hand. calendarType event is used because the page says a personal calendar needs exactly one team member and no user ID is known to this tool; the right type and the team member are set by hand. openHours is marked deprecated on the page but still supported. The calendar is created as a draft (isActive false).

api_fields.description: Next Level Answer. Bookings made by the AI receptionist and the booking link.

calendars._placeholders: Slot length, buffer, notice and hours are placeholders. The real ones come from the client's intake form. Connecting Google or Outlook is done by the client.

voice_agents.name: NL Receptionist (agent edition)
voice_agents.welcome_message: Thanks for calling {{custom_values.nl_biz_name}}. I am {{custom_values.nl_ai_name}}, an AI assistant for {{custom_values.nl_owner_name}}. How can I help you today?
voice_agents._verify: Whether the welcome message and the prompt render our own nl_ custom values is not confirmed (backlog item 7). If they do not, fill both per client by paste. The disclosure line needs counsel's approval. The agent is created with no phone number and no voice chosen; voice, advanced settings, the number and the Deploy tab are done by hand.
voice_agents._api_fields_note: maxCallDuration 600 is PROPOSED, Ray to set (allowed 180 to 900). The built-in post-call email is switched off because the summary is sent by NL 01 | AI call finished to nl_summary_email and nl_summary_mobile, and the built-in one would go to every admin user. Ray to confirm. businessName is left out so it defaults to the location name. callEndWorkflowIds is a confirmed field but needs the ID of a workflow that does not exist yet; set it by hand once NL 01 | AI call finished is built.

recording._verify: Not a field on the agent in the API reference. Set by hand on the phone number (Call Recording: disable). That a transcript and summary are still produced with recording off is blocking test 2 in TESTS-BEFORE-FIRST-CLIENT.md.

prompt_slots.text: You answer the phone for {{custom_values.nl_biz_name}}, a {{custom_values.nl_industry}} business serving {{custom_values.nl_service_area}}, with {{custom_values.nl_brokerage_name}}. You are an AI assistant named {{custom_values.nl_ai_name}}. You are not a licensed professional.

Find out who is calling and why, book a {{custom_values.nl_appointment_name}} or take a message, and end the call politely. Keep every reply to one or two sentences. Ask one question at a time. Ask the caller's name. Read back the number they are calling from and ask if it is the best one to reach them on.
You have already said you are an AI. Say so again whenever asked. Never claim to be a person.
If this line is not empty, say it right after the greeting: {{custom_values.nl_recording_line}}

Ask these in order. Skip any the caller has already answered. 1. {{custom_values.nl_q1}} 2. {{custom_values.nl_q2}} 3. {{custom_values.nl_q3}} 4. {{custom_values.nl_q4}} 5. {{custom_values.nl_q5}} If the caller says they already work with another agent, take a message only and do not offer a booking.

Answer questions only from this list. Hours: {{custom_values.nl_hours}}. Area served: {{custom_values.nl_service_area}}. {{custom_values.nl_faq_1}} {{custom_values.nl_faq_2}} {{custom_values.nl_faq_3}} {{custom_values.nl_faq_4}} {{custom_values.nl_faq_5}} If the answer is not here, say: I do not have that information. I will pass your question to {{custom_values.nl_owner_name}}. Never guess.

Never give: 1. An opinion on what a property is worth, what to offer, or whether a price is fair. 2. Legal, mortgage, tax, insurance or investment advice. 3. Whether a listing is still available, its price or its details. Take a message. 4. Anything about another client, another caller or another deal. 5. A claim that you are a person, or that a person is listening when none is. 6. A promise of a callback time, a result, a commission rate or a fee. 7. A comment on a neighbourhood's people, safety or schools. 8. Anything to a caller who says they are represented by another agent, beyond taking a message. 9. The owner's personal mobile number, home address or schedule. 10. Anything you are not sure of. Also never: {{custom_values.nl_not_allowed}}

Urgent means: {{custom_values.nl_urgent_definition}} Any request to speak to a person is also urgent. On an urgent call: confirm the name and the callback number, ask for the reason in one sentence, then say: I am sending this to {{custom_values.nl_owner_name}} right now and asking them to call you back {{custom_values.nl_callback_promise}}. Do not promise a time. Do not transfer the call. Then end the call.

Ask: Would you like to book a {{custom_values.nl_appointment_name}} with {{custom_values.nl_owner_name}}? Use the calendar action. Offer two times. Say the chosen day and time back. Say a confirmation text will follow. If nothing fits or the caller declines, take a message.
Speak {{custom_values.nl_languages}} only. If the caller speaks another language, say in English that a person will call back, take the number, and end the call.
Recap in one sentence. Say: {{custom_values.nl_owner_name}} will have this in a moment. Thanks for calling. End the call. Then write a call summary of two sentences at most.

actions.name: NL | Book a call
actions.intent: Book on the calendar above. Offer two times. Repeat the day and time.
actions._verify: The create-action page lists this actionType but shows the actionParameters fields for CALL_TRANSFER only. The fields for this type are not confirmed, so the tool does not create it. Build it by hand in the agent, or add actionParameters here and set create_via_api to true after reading the live page. Treat the first one as a test on a real call.

actions.name: NL | Save caller details
actions.intent: After the call, write NL | Caller reason, NL | Area of interest, NL | Timeline, NL | Callback number, NL | Urgent and NL | Call summary (two sentences).
